notes.title: v1.4 The Color Vision Deficiency Update!
notes.notes:
This update features small improvements, fixes, and most importantly, color vision deficiency modes! No gameplay information is exclusively communicated by color, but there are cases where it helps with clarity. These cases will now have more CVD friendly color palettes if one of the CVD modes is selected in the settings menu. If you believe I missed any areas or if the color choices are insufficient, please make a community post or email cd-support@suddenfrog.com to let me know! Now, on to the patch notes.


Added tritanopia CVD mode to the settings menu.
Added deuteranopia CVD mode to the settings menu.
Added protanopia CVD mode to the settings menu.
Added a skip button to the factory sections. This will appear once the game has been completed.
Added an eject animation to a mid-game mechanic.
Added more ambience to the bill payment screen.
Slightly lowered the volume on the bill payment screen.
Reworked how the chat messenger loads colors.
Fixed a bug where the retry button would not work in some ending scenarios.
Fixed some animation quirks on a certain ending door.
Fixed an end game mechanic that would unintentionally block click inputs on the monitor.

notes.title: Update v1.3 Out Now!
notes.notes:
We're starting out the new year with another round of fixes and polish! This will be the last update for a while as I will now be shifting my focus to color blindness settings, which are turning out to be very challenging to implement.


Popup ads will no longer close the category selection window.
Added a fail-safe in case bills get pushed off the screen somehow.
All late fees will now be condensed into a single object to make managing bills easier.
Fixed an issue where bills could be seen exiting the bottom of the shredder mid-shred.
Fixed several situations where clicking on a window did not bring it up to the front of the screen.
Fixed an issue where the camera could be toggled while the pause menu or day summary screen are open.
Reworded tip #3.
Added glitch effect to FWLR file purchases
Small audio and visual improvements to the shredder.
Greatly improved the secret ending.


The I.H.A. wishes you a happy new year and demands that you get back to work!

notes.title: Update v1.2 Out Now!
notes.notes:
This update features small gameplay adjustments, quality of life improvements, as well as some visual upgrades and bug fixes!


Added an indication of puzzle completion outside of the app itself.
Lowered the shaking required for popup ads.
Increased scroll wheel sensitivity on the products tab.
Made high-level mid-day music slightly harder to trigger.
The phone now stops ringing after reaching a fail state.
Added a sound effect for reaching a new high score in the custom game.
The same voice line will now be less likely to play back to back.
Improved "h" achievement detection.
Reworded a few achievement descriptions.
Reworded tip #2.
Improved FWLR files audio.
Improved visuals for FWLR files screen.
Improved visuals for factory scene.
Improved the main monitor sprite.
Fixed an issue where custom game high scores were not saving properly.
Fixed a crash caused by PCs set to use the Buddhist calendar.
Fixed a case where the camera could pan too far below the screen on the main menu.
Fixed a circumstance where a penalty would be issued for using the hand scanner slightly too late.

notes.title: Update v1.1 Out Now!
notes.notes:
This updates includes a few fail state bug fixes and save game optimizations.


Fixed some situations where the save game system would cause the game to crash.
Fixed situations where multiple fail states could stack, causing the end screen to change each time.
Fixed situations where the day could complete after hitting a fail state.
Fixed visuals for a certain end-game mechanic not lining up with the game state.
Fixed situations where the sanity puzzle could be completed and still fail the player.
Fixed strange "wiggle" effect on the timeline screen.
Fixed some story progress cases that were not accounted for.
